name: 前挡全覆盖防晒隔热遮阳挡款
description: 七镜漏斗：白底主图、装车利益、重叠机构、微距与空白适配表收口

styleLock.direction: premium automotive interior accessory ecommerce with a cool daylight safety mood
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, cool grey-blue #EDF1F6 for banner and variant screens, deep navy #1F3557 and charcoal cabin #2B313A for macro and in-cabin screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool neutral 5500-6000K; bright even high-key softbox key with soft fill and soft contact shadows on studio screens; low-key daylight entering through the covered glass inside the cabin; skimming light only for texture macro
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte studio seamless board #EDF1F6 and #FFFFFF for flat screens, dark textured cabin dash and headliner for in-cabin screens
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, deep navy #1F3557 headlines on light panels and pure white #FFFFFF headlines on dark panels, one headline plus up to three short labels per screen
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and double-headed adjustment arrows in orange #F39A1E on dark panels, deep navy #1F3557 on light panels, rounded pill label chips
styleLock.presentationRules: the shade always reads as one flat rounded-corner panel with dark stitched edge binding, stable scale and centering, shown laid flat, fitted on glass, or rolled into its pouch; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
noDrift: no real car brand badges, model names or year lists
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium automotive interior accessory visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, cool grey-blue #EDF1F6, deep navy #1F3557 and one orange accent #F39A1E; cool neutral studio lighting at 5500-6000K with bright even high-key softbox light on white screens and low-key daylight inside the cabin; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line icon system with double-headed arrows and rounded pill chips; flat panel product always shown with dark stitched edge binding, stable scale and centering; one complete balanced layout per screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用平整铺开的整块挡面赢下合规主图位
shots.camera: 机位 straight-on eye-level，挡面正对镜头整块铺开，全品可见不裁边
shots.lighting: 明亮均匀 high-key 棚光，正面主光加柔光板补光，软接触阴影落地
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The panel spread flat and squarely facing the lens, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible with its stitched edge binding and nothing cropped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and a soft fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding the panel. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace around it. 8K commercial automotive e-commerce quality. Negative: no car, no hands, no props, no watermark, no fake logo or lettering on the binding, no extra text, no decorative graphics, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating panel without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清装车后整片前挡被覆盖的核心利益
shots.camera: 机位 very low angle looking slightly upward，自车头保险杠高度的 3/4 前脸视角
shots.lighting: 冷中性 6000K 棚光自左上，挡风玻璃上一道柔和 sweeping 高光，车底软阴影
shots.props: 一辆无标识的中性石墨灰双门车 #4A4F57 作为承载体
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper band for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A generic unbranded graphite car #4A4F57 with blank badge areas, shown from a very low angle looking slightly upward at a 3/4 front view, the product fitted across its whole windscreen, vehicle and glass occupying 50-60% of the frame and centred. Cool neutral studio light at 6000K from the upper left with one soft sweeping highlight across the windscreen and a gentle grounding shadow under the tyres. Seamless cool grey-blue studio backdrop #EDF1F6 with generous negative space in the upper band for copy. One short headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 set in #1F3557 across that upper band, completing one balanced layout. Negative: no recognizable car brand emblem, grille badge or trademarked body detailing, no license-plate text, no dealership signage, no people, no other vehicles, no invented coverage or ultraviolet percentages, no dense body text, no watermark.

shots.displayName: 车内视角重叠调幅机构
shots.intent: 从车内仰视已覆盖的前挡，并用两格小图演示宽度可重叠调节的机构
shots.camera: 机位 from inside the cabin, low angle looking upward，仪表台高度仰视前挡内侧，底部两格平铺小图
shots.lighting: 低光调车内环境，5500K 日光透过挡面柔和渗入，无读数仪表
shots.background: 炭黑车内顶棚与仪表台 #2B313A
shots.props: 无标识后视镜与两片遮阳板，仅作为结构锚点
shots.whitespace: clear annotation column kept free on the right 30% for copy
shots.textZone: 右侧标注列一枚双箭头标签，「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce mechanism screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera positioned inside the cabin at dashboard height looking upward at the covered windscreen, then two small flat inset panels along the bottom showing the same product with its segments nested together and with its segments spread apart, a thin double-headed arrow between the two insets. Dim cool 5500K daylight filtering softly through the reflective face, low-key cabin interior, gentle shadows, no readable instrumentation. Dark charcoal cabin interior #2B313A. The product and the two insets together occupy 50-60% of the frame with a clear annotation column kept free on the right 30%. One short label placeholder 「{callout_1}」 in #F39A1E beside the arrow. Negative: no readable gauge dials, segment displays or screen digits, no numeric arrows with inch or cm units, no faces, no hands, no invented fitment claims, no fake logo, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用两格真实装车步骤让人代入，证明安装无需工具
shots.camera: 机位 eye-level from the passenger-seat side，上下两格匹配取景，人物取背影与颈下裁切
shots.lighting: 明亮自然日光自前挡涌入并轻微过曝，5500K，车内柔和阴影，纪实抓拍感
shots.background: 明亮中性车内空间与前挡透光 #F7F9FB
shots.props: 无标识方向盘与仪表台轮廓，两片遮阳板
shots.whitespace: clear band at the bottom of each panel for copy
shots.textZone: 上下两格底部条带各一枚，「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: Two-panel lifestyle scene showing how {product} goes in. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two stacked matched panels framed from the passenger-seat side at eye level: upper panel a generic adult framed from behind and cropped below the neck, both hands lifting the panel up against the windscreen; lower panel the same figure in side profile from the shoulder down, hands pressing the sun visors over its edge. Bright natural daylight at 5500K blowing out gently through the glass, soft cabin shadows, candid documentary feel rather than staged studio. Bright neutral cabin interior #F7F9FB. The product occupies 40-50% of each panel, with a clear band left at the bottom of each panel for copy. Short labels 「{callout_1}」 on the upper panel and 「{callout_2}」 on the lower panel in #1F3557. Negative: no identifiable face or frontal portrait, no extra or deformed fingers, no brand marks on clothing, no car badges or trademarked interior details, no tools, no watermark, no extra text beyond the two labels.

shots.intent: 用织纹与双道缝线的微距证据代替参数，证明面料与做工
shots.camera: 机位 extreme close-up macro, tight zoom，浅景深，前景清晰远处柔化
shots.lighting: 左侧 skimming 掠射光扫出织纹与缝线，一道受控窄高光，无过曝反射
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom where the woven reflective face meets the stitched edge binding. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground threads sharp and the far edge falling softly out of focus, the detail filling 55-60% of the frame. Skimming side light sweeping in from the left to reveal the weave and the double stitch line, one controlled narrow highlight, no blown speculars. Out-of-focus deep navy backdrop #1F3557 with minimal extra whitespace because the texture is the subject. One small caption chip in the lower left reading 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF. Negative: no blurry subject, no denier counts or coating figures, no material codes, no brand mark or lettered stitching, no repeated tile pattern in the background, no contradictory light direction, no watermark.

shots.intent: 并排展示多档尺寸梯度与随附收纳袋，让买家自行选择规格
shots.camera: 机位 straight-on eye-level row，三件同角度同比例自左至右由宽到窄排列
shots.lighting: 均匀 high-key 柔光，三件接触阴影一致，无混合光
shots.props: 右侧一只收拢的素面收纳袋，三枚空白胶囊标记
shots.whitespace: clear headline band across the top
shots.textZone: 顶部标题条一条加三枚空白胶囊位，「{selling_point_1}」「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three units of the same product laid in a straight-on eye-level row at identical scale and identical angle, narrowing from left to right, one rolled storage pouch with a blank face standing at the right end, a blank pill-shaped marker floating above each unit. Even high-key soft studio light with matching soft contact shadows on all items, no mixed lighting and no drifting highlights. Seamless cool grey-blue backdrop #EDF1F6. The row occupies 50-60% of the frame with a clear headline band across the top. Headline placeholder 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1F3557 plus three empty pill markers reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」. Negative: no real dimension numbers, size letters or unit labels, no brand mark on the pouch, no mixed lighting or inconsistent scale between units, no duplicated identical panels, no dense body text, no watermark.

shots.displayName: 空白适配表与配件全家福
shots.intent: 以空白车型适配表结构与整套配件收口，消除适配与缺件疑虑
shots.camera: 机位 flat lay, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: 均匀高亮 flat 棚光，无戏剧阴影，版式清爽可读
shots.props: 折叠后的本品、收纳袋、右侧一张三列空白适配表卡片
shots.whitespace: generous whitespace inside the empty card on the right
shots.textZone: 右侧三列表头各一枚，「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，所有表格单元保持空白
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and fitment screen. {product} folded neatly beside its rolled storage pouch on the left, a three-column fitment card with completely empty cells filling the right side, arranged as a flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat studio lighting, no dramatic shadow, crisp readable column grid on a thin deep navy rule. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product and pouch occupy 35-40% of the frame while the blank card holds the right two thirds with generous whitespace inside its cells. Three column headers 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #1F3557 above empty rows, closing as one finished balanced layout. Negative: no real car makes, models, years or trim names, no filled spec values, percentages or test figures, no trademark symbols, no fake certification seals or platform badges, no dense body text, no barcode, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 六图源事实：001 白底平铺挡面加装车整车示意；002/003 为按品牌-车型-年款排布的适配清单页（两页同角色，合并为一镜空白表结构）；004 车内仰视已覆盖前挡加底部两格重叠示意与双向箭头；005 顶部尺寸标线、三枚圆形细节插图（织纹、重叠缝位、收纳袋）；006 上下两格安装步骤并含可辨识人脸。品类判定依据：产品安装于前挡内侧、无电加热或电机部件，故归「汽车用品-内饰」，与源路径提示一致，未改判。已剥离内容：整车主图中的车标与格栅特征、车牌字样、收纳袋上的原品牌字标与图形、适配表中全部车型名称与年款数字、尺寸标线与页面内全部原英文标语与主张、卖点页的重叠幅度数值与面料规格字样、006 中模特面容身份（改为背影与颈下裁切）；全部数值与资质主张改由 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 占位或空白表单元承载。
